admission.claim: An mbstring regex-facing entry path accepts a non-empty pattern and forwards it into Oniguruma compilation through `php_mbregex_compile_pattern()`.

root.claim: During regex compilation, `tune_quant()` reaches an empty-repeat analysis handoff where a zero-length quantifier body is passed to `quantifiers_memory_node_info()` as the subtree later involved in the reported UAF read.

target.claim: The same subtree pointer handed off by `tune_quant()` is later consumed in `quantifiers_memory_node_info()` when that function dereferences the node to inspect its type and recurse through children.
target.predicate: uaf_read.hit && empty_repeat_analysis.hit && uaf_read.time > empty_repeat_analysis.time && uaf_read.capture.node == empty_repeat_analysis.capture.body
